posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
I don't think we're gonna hit 1000 before GenCon's done. But it'll be interesting to see how long it takes...

In the biggest upset ever, Chrono-Ranger, Freedom Six Tempest, Dark Watch Expatriette and Eternal Haka took the Chairman down, and I mean downtown, in the Final Wasteland, no Unforgiving Wasteland needed! That impossible challenge taught me something, it seems!

Try as they might, Argent Adept, Dark Visionary, Youngest Legacy and Bunker could not repel Miss Information's assault on Insula Primalis.

Mr. Fixer, Redeemer Fanatic and Visionary fell to Kaargra Warfang and her Gladiators at Megalopolis, no points necessary.

Grand Warlord Voss crumbled like a house of cards before the mighty onslaught of Legacy, Haka, Tempest and the Wraith. Hilariously, Omnitron-IV's Defense Grid would have taken him out, if not for a just-played Mega Computer.

Ra: Horus of Two Horizons and Dark Watch Nightmist were able to keep the Scholar alive through the game from hell: versus Skinwalker Gloomweaver at Pike Industral Plant, for at least a solid hour.

To add insult to injury, after banishing Gloomweaver from this plane of existence, Ra and the Scholar of the Infinite dragged Unity to the Realm of Discord to kick his butt again and leave him there for keeps.

Freedom Six Unity, Expatriette, America's Greatest Legacy, Rook City Wraith and Super Scientific Tachyon took on seven of the Ennead in the Ruins of Atlantis. Tachyon finished things by bouncing a Sonic Vortex off herself to hit Geb twice. :D

G.I. Bunker, Freedom Six Wraith, Omnitron-X and Tachyon learned it is not a good idea to face the Dreamer in Silver Gulch because she kills everything. :(

Captain Cosmic, Dark Watch Mister Fixer, Fanatic and Super Scientific Tachyon taught Deadline that (destroying) time (Cataclysm) doesn't pay. :V

Total Games: 145

I had nothing to do today but play Sentinels, why do you ask? :B
